message.content:
This vertical editorial cover features the word "TEMPO" in large, red, serif capitals across its upper half. Above it, white text reads "Teka-Teki Penggantian Ketua BPPN". Below the "T" is smaller text: "EDISI 10 - 16 September 2001". Larger white text in the center reads "RAME-RAME MENAMBANG HIBAH DI SENAYAN".

An illustration occupies the bottom half against an orange-to-yellow gradient sky. A central figure with black, pointed, wing-like clothing lies sprawled across the hood and roof of a golden, rounded car. The car has a license plate reading "DPR". The figure has a white collar and a striped tie. Its head is replaced by a massive, green, double-lobed structure resembling a broad hat or organic growth. The figure’s black legs extend toward the bottom left. In the background, dark, jagged silhouettes of structures with utility poles and wires are visible. In the bottom left corner is a barcode with the numbers "00028" and "9 770123 427302". In the bottom right corner, text reads "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN" and "Rp 10.800".
